Record a decision on a run

pk_decide.Rd

Accepts or rejects a run, or sets it back to pending. A reason is mandatory for "accepted" and "rejected", because the rationale for model development decisions is part of the audit trail. The decision is stored in the ledger and appended to the event log (events.csv), so earlier decisions stay visible with pk_audit().

Usage

pk_decide(
  run,
  decision = c("accepted", "rejected", "pending"),
  reason = NA_character_,
  quiet = FALSE,
  proj = NULL
)

Arguments

run

A run reference or a run id.

decision

"accepted", "rejected" or "pending".

reason

Free-text rationale (required unless decision = "pending").

quiet

Suppress the confirmation message?

proj

A pk_project object. Defaults to the current project.

Value

The run reference (invisibly).
